citations.assessment: The Yerushalmi gives Yehudah bar Safra reporting R. Hoshaya on the festival offering and Shabbat.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015

citations.assessment: The Bavli explicitly transmits the teaching from Yehudah ben Safra through Il’a. The underlying festival-offering proof is shared with the Yerushalmi, whose chain names Hoshaya.

notes.text: The proofs overlap. The Yerushalmi credits Yehudah bar Safra reporting Hoshaya, and the Bavli credits Ilai reporting Yehudah ben Safra.
